original.statement: The Argo CD UI now splits arrays in YAML display to fix ambiguous collapse behavior when array items contain nested objects.

decision.reason: [ev-392c5d206c38] only lists a UI feature: arrays in the web UI's YAML view are now split so that collapsing them is no longer ambiguous when items contain nested objects. That is a change to how the UI displays YAML, not wire or protocol behaviour, so the protocol-behavior family is wrong. The evidence names no config, API, flag or other subject that any family covers, so no typed assertion follows from it.
